text: This solution, Ready to Rebuild: Disaster Rehabilitation and Recovery Program (R2R Program) addresses natural catastrophe in Philippines between Government of the Philippines, National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), Office of Civil Defense (OCD), Department of Science and Technology (DOST), Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) agencies (BPDA, MILG), World Bank, Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR), and Japan-World Bank Program for Mainstreaming DRM. The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
